text:
Jules: Quick flag 1 interviews created overnight show no scorecard link in the interviewer email. happened after the schema change?

Emma (People Ops): thanks for calling out. do you have an example interview id?

Jules: int_902 sample. the email shows "Your interview materials" but the link goes to a 404 and payload has scorecard_id=null.

Webhook Bot: event=interview.created id=int_902 delivered status=200

Aisha - Recruiting Ops: ugh. i just had an interviewer ping me. they couldn't find the form. cc'ing devs.

Devon - Eng: probably the template renaming we deployed last night (template_id -> template_handle). the compatibility shim should set template_handle when template_id exists. i'll check logs.

Devon - Eng: log snippet: "KeyError: 'template_id' in compat_mapper.py:42". shim crashed but webhook returned 200.

Emma (People Ops): we need a quick mitigation so interviews don't get stale. can recruiting set a fallback template?

Aisha - Recruiting Ops: yes we can. what's the fallback? usually use "interviewer-default-v2".

Devon - Eng: we can run a small patch to set template_handle=interviewer-default-v2 for affected rows. i'll run in staging first and paste results.

Jules: i can run a query if you need IDs.

Devon - Eng: run this against reporting: ```sql
SELECT id, interview_id, created_at FROM interviews WHERE COALESCE(template_handle, '') = '' AND created_at >= '2024-06-20' AND created_at < '2024-06-22';
``` got 11 rows when i ran it in staging.

Aisha - Recruiting Ops: uploaded CSV to #people-ops-ops. please patch.

Devon - Eng: staging patch applied. sample int_902 now has template_handle=interviewer-default-v2. job id job-7782. no regressions found in smoke check.

Emma (People Ops): ok go ahead to prod after devon posts the prod job id here. also add an incident note for ops runbook updates.

Devon - Eng: prod patch started at 2024-06-21T16:05Z job-id job-7789. patched 11 interviews. returning success.

Devon - Eng: opened ticket RECRUIT-913 to add better error bubbling on compat shim and add test coverage for schema migrations.

Jules: thanks team. follow-up: can we add a one-click "resend materials" in the ATS UI for interviewers when this happens? saves time for recruiting.

Aisha - Recruiting Ops: that would help. adding to our backlog and we'll scope with devs.

Emma (People Ops): i'll draft a short FAQ for interviewers explaining the temporary workaround (use direct link in ATS) and ETA for UI improvement. posting to handbook.
